biography:
Matt Berry (born May 2, 1974, in Bromham, Bedfordshire, England) is an English actor, comedian, writer, singer, songwriter, and multi-instrumentalist. Although widely recognized for television roles in The IT Crowd, The Mighty Boosh, and Toast of London, Berry has maintained a substantial musical career rooted in his early interest in artists such as Mike Oldfield. His recordings combine acid-jazz sensibilities with progressive rock, psychedelic folk, electronic music, vintage library textures, and pastoral British pop.

Berry’s solo discography includes Witchazel (2011), Kill the Wolf (2013), Music for Insomniacs (2014), Phantom Birds (2020), The Blue Elephant (2021), Simplicity (2023), and Heard Noises (2025), many released through Acid Jazz Records. He frequently plays numerous instruments himself and performs with the Maypoles, creating music that is both deliberately retro and highly personal. His ability to move between comedy, studio experimentation, and carefully crafted songwriting has established him as an distinctive contemporary cult artist whose recordings extend well beyond his screen persona.

lastfm.bio_content: Matt Berry (born 1974 in Bromham, Bedfordshire) is a British actor, writer and musician known for his deep, booming voice and a grand, rather roguish but charming manner. When not creating numerous indelible characters on a variety of British and American TV shows, multi-instrumentalist Matt Berry spends his time re-creating the sounds of the obscure albums he collects on songs that blend gentle British folk, wistful psychedelia, and rambling prog rock. Teaming with the venerable Acid Jazz label, Berry released a series of albums that explored pastoral folk-rock (2013's Kill the Wolf), new age synthesizer music (2014's Music for Insomniacs), country-rock (2020's Phantom Birds), and spot-on psychedelia (2021's Blue Elephant.) No matter the stylistic route he chooses, Berry plays it straight, and his surprisingly tender vocals, skills at a variety of instruments, and knack for a hook make it clear that he's not just an actor dabbling in music as a hobby. theaudiodb.biography_en:
Matthew Charles "Matt" Berry (born 2 May 1974) is an English actor, writer, comedian and musician. Berry is perhaps best known for his appearances in The IT Crowd, Garth Marenghi's Darkplace, The Mighty Boosh, and Snuff Box. He is renowned for his deep voice; he has voiced several advertisements, most notably for Volvic, The Natural Confectionery Company, Absolute Radio, and MoneySupermarket.

As a musician, Berry composed all the music for Snuff Box, as well as the music for AD/BC: A Rock Opera, which he co-wrote with Richard Ayoade. AD/BC was a half-hour parody of overblown musicals in general and Jesus Christ Superstar in particular, telling the story of the innkeeper who allowed Mary, Joseph, and the baby Jesus to sleep in his manger. AD/BC was broadcast in December 2004 and featured Fulcher and Mighty Boosh stars Julian Barratt and Noel Fielding. He also performed a song for an episode of Garth Marenghi's Darkplace entitled "One Track Lover", a spoof of cheesy romantic 80s songs.
